reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "spec.conversion.webhookClientConfig: Forbidden: should not be set when strategy is not set to Webhook: Use `0.16.1` as opposed to `0.16.0` on your installation…", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: upgrade-blocked

consequence.statement: Installing 0.16.0 can fail with 'spec.conversion.webhookClientConfig: Forbidden: should not be set when strategy is not set to Webhook'.
consequence.remediation: Use 0.16.1 instead of 0.16.0 on your installation path; the guide says 0.16.1 should fix this.

proposed.statement: The 0.16.0 troubleshooting guide says installing 0.16.0 can fail with "spec.conversion.webhookClientConfig: Forbidden: should not be set when strategy is not set to Webhook", and that 0.16.1 should be used instead because it fixes this.
